SELECT exit_at AS time, sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS metric, SUM(pnl_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY sim_metadata->>'strategy' ORDER BY exit_at) AS value FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' AND exit_at IS NOT NULL AND sim_metadata->>'strategy' IN ('cluster','conviction','teamfollow','cohortfire','promobuy') ORDER BY exit_at

SELECT sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS strategy, id, asset, venue AS chain, ROUND(size_usd::numeric,0) AS size_usd, entry_price, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric,1) AS peak_pct, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'entry_liquidity_usd')::numeric,0) AS entry_liq, entry_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='open' ORDER BY entry_at DESC

SELECT sim_metadata->>'strategy' AS strategy, id, asset, ROUND((sim_metadata->>'peak_pct_since_entry')::numeric,1) AS peak_pct, ROUND(pnl_pct::numeric,2) AS pnl_pct, ROUND(pnl_usd::numeric,2) AS pnl_usd, exit_reason, entry_at, exit_at FROM trades WHERE bot_id='copy' AND mode='paper' AND fill_status='closed' ORDER BY exit_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50

SELECT process_name, last_ping_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_ping_at))::int AS seconds_ago, CASE WHEN last_ping_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 'live' ELSE 'stale' END AS status FROM heartbeats ORDER BY process_name
SELECT bot_id, halt_type, severity, halted_at, resumed_at, LEFT(reason, 80) AS reason FROM halts WHERE halted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY halted_at DESC LIMIT 30
